summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing the resubmission of its Biologics License Application (BLA) for ONS-5010/LYTENAVA to the FDA. The filing does not involve a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation. It describes a regulatory milestone following a successful appeal of a previous Complete Response Letter, with a Class 1 resubmission expected to receive a PDUFA decision within 60 days. The registrant is the issuer reporting material corporate development. This is a routine regulatory update, not a special-situation event such as a take-private, spin-off, restructuring, or activist campaign.
